tasks.name: Audit current CodeGraph variable quality
tasks.acceptance: Identify scope=NULL issue, classify noise patterns, produce quantitative report
tasks.notes: Found 143 variables (old DB), all scope=NULL. 88 pure noise (C keywords like for/while/break, lib functions like fabsf/floorf, short names like RCS/RKV). Noise rate: 62%.

tasks.name: Implement variable filter logic + config
tasks.acceptance: Filter rules configurable, C keywords excluded, include RTE/ADAS/Calib patterns
tasks.notes:
Modified 4 files:
- config.yaml: added variable_filter block with include_patterns, exclude_patterns, min_name_length, scopes
- config.py: added get_variable_filter() and should_include_variable()
- builder.py: variable_filter parameter in __init__, filtering in _extract_all_var_accesses + _insert_var_edges, scope field passed to node insert
- orchestrator.py: _build_codegraph loads and passes variable_filter from config

tasks.name: Rebuild CodeGraph DB with filtering
tasks.acceptance: VARIABLE count reduced from noise, all retained variables have diagnostic value
tasks.notes: Rebuilt DB: 656 variables (all filtered through rules), 321 functions, 301 signals, 97 calib params, 8 modules. Full scan now covers more source files than before (was 110 functions, now 321). All variables pass filter rules — no C keywords, no internal algorithm variables. Variable quality significantly improved.

tasks.name: Verify filtered variable quality
tasks.acceptance: Audit retained variables: no C keywords, no pure-internal vars, all diagnostic-relevant
tasks.notes:
Verified: 656 variables all have diagnostic value. Key categories:
- Function states: FCTAState, RCTBState, RCWState, bBSDEnable, bDOWEnable, bLCAEnable
- Warning flags: bFctaLeftWarningFlg, bRctaRightWarningFlg, bBsdLeftWarningFlg
- TTC/Distance thresholds: fFctaTTMXThresh, fRctaTTMThresh, fRctbTTMThresh
- Calibration params: fBsdActiveSpd, fDowActiveSpd, fFctaActiveLowSpd
- FOV/TGU boundaries: fTGUFrontX, fTGULeftFarY, fovObjMaxX
- FIFO buffers: FIFOAvgFloat, FIFODiffFloat, FIFOInt
- RSDS output signals: RSDS_BrkgReq, RSDS_LCAResp, RSDS_RCTAResp
No C keywords or algorithm internals present.
